```{r}
#| include: false

# Packages
library(tidyverse)
library(AOData)
library(lme4)
library(gt)
library(marginaleffects)
library(cowplot)
library(ggtext)


# Settings for figures

colors <- c("#e66101", "#fdb863","#b2abd2","#5e3c99")
basesize <- 18



```




## Participants

```{r}
#| label: "fig-fig1"
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-cap: "Participants included in per protocol analysis (completed *T4*). Bars in the histogram are stacked."



part <- AOData::idkeys %>%
  filter(completed == "t4")


## Descriptives data 

dat <- AOData::bodycomp %>%
  select(participant, time, lean.whole, BMC.whole, fat.whole)  %>%
  mutate(weight = lean.whole + BMC.whole + fat.whole) %>%
  inner_join(part %>% mutate(participant = as.character(participant))) %>%
  filter(time == "T1") %>%
  ## Calculate height based on weight (DXA) and BMI 
  mutate(height = 100 * sqrt((weight/1000) / bmi)) %>%
  ## Calculate relative lean and fat
  mutate(lean.rel = 100 * (lean.whole / weight), 
         fat.rel = 100 * (fat.whole/weight), 
         # Weight in kg
         weight = weight / 1000) %>%
  select(participant, 
         treat, 
         completed, 
         sex, 
         age, 
         height, 
         weight, 
         lean.rel, 
         fat.rel, 
         bmi) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = age:bmi)

## Summarise descriptives
dat_sum <- dat %>%
  summarise(.by = c(sex, name), 
            m = mean(value), 
            s = sd(value), 
            n = n()) %>%
  mutate(stat = paste0(sprintf("%.1f", round(m, 1)), 
                       " (", 
                       sprintf("%.1f", round(s, 1)), 
                       ")")) %>%
  mutate(name = factor(name, levels = c("age", 
                                        "height", 
                                        "weight", 
                                        "bmi", 
                                        "lean.rel", 
                                        "fat.rel"), 
                       labels = c("Age (yrs)", 
                                  "Stature (cm)", 
                                  "Body mass (kg)", 
                                  "Body mass index", 
                                  "Lean mass (%)", 
                                  "Fat mass (%)")), 
         sex = factor(sex, levels = c("f", "m"), 
                      labels = c("Female", "Male"))) %>%
  mutate(.by = name, 
         pos = mean(m) + 1 * mean(s)) %>%
    mutate(.by = sex, 
         sex_n = paste(sex, "n = ",mean(n)))




p <- dat %>%
   mutate(name = factor(name, levels = c("age", 
                                        "height", 
                                        "weight", 
                                        "bmi", 
                                        "lean.rel", 
                                        "fat.rel"), 
                       labels = c("Age (yrs)", 
                                  "Stature (cm)", 
                                  "Body mass (kg)", 
                                  "Body mass index", 
                                  "Lean mass (%)", 
                                  "Fat mass (%)")), 
         sex = factor(sex, levels = c("f", "m"), 
                      labels = c("Female", "Male"))) %>%
  mutate(.by = c(sex,name), 
         sex_n = paste(sex, "n = ",n())) %>%
  
  
  ggplot(aes(value, color = sex_n, fill = sex_n)) + 
  geom_histogram(bins = 20, color = "gray10") + 
  
  geom_richtext(data = filter(dat_sum, sex == "Male"), 
            aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, color = sex_n, label = paste("&#9794;",stat)), 
                hjust = -1.6, vjust = 1, 
              show.legend = FALSE,
                 fill = NA, label.color = NA, # remove background and outline
    label.padding = grid::unit(rep(0, 4), "pt")) + # remove padding) +
   geom_richtext(data = filter(dat_sum, sex == "Female"), 
               aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, color = sex_n, label = paste("&#9792;",stat)),
               show.legend = FALSE,
                hjust = -1.6, vjust = 2.5, 
                 fill = NA, label.color = NA, # remove background and outline
    label.padding = grid::unit(rep(0, 4), "pt")) + # remove padding) 
  
  
  scale_color_manual(values = c(colors[1], colors[3])) + 
 scale_fill_manual(values = c(colors[1], colors[3])) +  
  
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 26)) +
  facet_wrap(~ name, scales = "free") + 
  labs(y = "Count") +
  
  
  theme_classic(base_size = basesize) + 
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(color = "white"), 
        strip.text = element_text(hjust = 0), 
        legend.title = element_blank(), 
        axis.title.x = element_blank(), 
        legend.position = "bottom")
  
  p


ggsave("ecss-2024-figures/fig1.pdf", 
       p,
       width = 24, 
       device = cairo_pdf,
       height = 16, units = "cm")

```






```{r}
#| label: tbl-participants
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| echo: false
#| tbl-cap: "Characteristics of participants completing T4. Data are presented as Mean (SD)."






## Participants
# Only from completed to T4
part <- AOData::idkeys %>%
  filter(completed == "t4")


part %>%
  select(participant:bmi) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(age, bmi)) %>%
  
  
  summarise(.by = c(treat, sex, name),
            m = mean(value), 
            s = sd(value), 
            n = n()) %>%
  
  pivot_wider(names_from = name, values_from = c(m,s,n)) %>%
  select(-n_age) %>%
  pivot_wider(values_from = m_age:n_bmi,
              names_from = treat) %>%
  mutate(sex = if_else(sex == "m", "Male", "Female")) %>%
  

  
  
  gt() %>%
  
  fmt_number(columns = starts_with("m"), decimals = 1) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = starts_with("s"), decimals = 1) %>%
  
  cols_merge(columns = c("m_age_omega", "s_age_omega"), 
             pattern = "<<{1}>> <<({2})>>") %>%
    cols_merge(columns = c("m_bmi_omega", "s_bmi_omega"), 
             pattern = "<<{1}>> <<({2})>>") %>%
  
    cols_merge(columns = c("m_age_ctrl", "s_age_ctrl"), 
             pattern = "<<{1}>> <<({2})>>") %>%
    cols_merge(columns = c("m_bmi_ctrl", "s_bmi_ctrl"), 
             pattern = "<<{1}>> <<({2})>>") %>%
  
  
  cols_move(m_bmi_ctrl, m_age_ctrl) %>%
  cols_move(n_bmi_ctrl, m_bmi_ctrl) %>%
  
  cols_label(sex = "Sex") %>%
  tab_spanner(label = "Placebo", 
              columns = c(m_age_ctrl,m_bmi_ctrl,n_bmi_ctrl)) %>%
    tab_spanner(label = "Omega-3", 
              columns = c(m_age_omega,m_bmi_omega,n_bmi_omega)) %>%
  cols_label(m_age_ctrl = "Age", 
             m_bmi_ctrl = "BMI", 
             n_bmi_ctrl = "n", 
             m_age_omega = "Age", 
             m_bmi_omega = "BMI", 
             n_bmi_omega = "n" )
  
  
            



```

```{r}
#| include: false



## Data preparation

## Vastus lateralis data 
dat_fm <-   part %>% 
  mutate(participant = as.character(participant)) %>%
  inner_join(AOData::bodycomp) %>%

  
  mutate(rel.fm = 100 * (fat.whole / (fat.whole + lean.whole + BMC.whole))) %>%
  
  select(participant, time, sex, bmi, rel.fm) %>%
  inner_join(mutate(AOData::thickness, participant = as.character(participant))) %>%
  
  select(-VIthick) %>%
  
  pivot_wider(names_from = time, values_from = c(VLthick, rel.fm), 
              values_fn = mean)








```


## Training conditions and outcome agreement 


```{r}
#| label: "fig-fig2"
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 4
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-cap: !expr 'glue::glue("Association between training-induced relative changes in response to 10RM and 30RM training conditions. Leg lean mass, {cres_lean}; Average unilateral strength, {cres_str}; Vastus lateralis thickness, {cres_vl}.")'


# Vastus thickness
dat_vl <- dat_fm %>%
  
  mutate(change = 100 * ((VLthick_T4 / VLthick_T2) -1)) %>%
  filter(condition != "RMNA") %>%
  
  mutate() %>%
  
  
  select(participant, condition, change) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = condition, 
              values_from = change)



## (Average) Strength data 
dat_str <- AOData::strength %>%
  
  inner_join(part) %>%
  
  select(participant:mag) %>%
  filter(time %in% c("T2", "T4"), 
         condition != "RMNA", 
         mag > 5) %>%
 
  mutate(.by = exercise, 
         mag = mag/max(mag)) %>%
  summarise(.by = c(participant, condition, time), 
            mag = mean(mag)) %>%
  

  pivot_wider(names_from = time, values_from = mag) %>%
  mutate(change_str = 100 * ((T4/T2)-1), 
         participant = as.character(participant)) %>%
  
  inner_join(part %>% 
               mutate(participant = as.character(participant)) %>%
               inner_join(AOData::bodycomp) %>%
               
               
               
               
               mutate(rel.fm = 100 * (fat.whole / (fat.whole + lean.whole + BMC.whole))) %>%
              
               filter(time == "T2") %>%
               select(participant, rel.fm, sex)) %>%
  select(participant, condition, change_str) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = condition, values_from = change_str) 
  

## Lean leg mass data
dat_lean <- part %>% 
  mutate(participant = as.character(participant)) %>%
  inner_join(AOData::bodycomp) %>%
  
  mutate(rel.fm = 100 * (fat.whole / (fat.whole + lean.whole + BMC.whole))) %>%
  
  select(participant, time, sex, bmi, rel.fm, lean.right_leg, lean.left_leg) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = lean.right_leg:lean.left_leg, 
               values_to = "lean_leg", 
               names_to = "leg") %>%
  mutate(leg = if_else(leg == "lean.right_leg", "R", "L")) %>%

  inner_join(mutate(AOData::thickness, participant = as.character(participant))) %>%
  select(-VIthick) %>%

  filter(time %in% c("T2", "T4")) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = time, 
              values_from = c(VLthick, lean_leg, rel.fm)) %>%
  
  mutate(change_lean = 100 * ((lean_leg_T4 / lean_leg_T2)-1), 
         abs_change_lean = lean_leg_T4 - lean_leg_T2,
         change_thick = VLthick_T4- VLthick_T2)  %>%
 
  filter(condition != "RMNA") %>%



  select(participant, condition, change_lean) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = condition, values_from = change_lean) 


## Correlation coefficient
ct_vl <- cor.test(dat_vl$RM10, dat_vl$RM30)
ct_str <- cor.test(dat_str$RM10, dat_str$RM30)
ct_lean <- cor.test(dat_lean$RM10, dat_lean$RM30)


cres_vl <-paste0("r = ", 
             round(ct_vl$estimate,2), 
             ", 95% CI: [",
             round(ct_vl$conf.int[1],2), 
             ", ",
             round(ct_vl$conf.int[2],2), 
             "]")

cres_str <-paste0("r = ", 
             round(ct_str$estimate,2), 
             ", 95% CI: [",
             round(ct_str$conf.int[1],2), 
             ", ",
             round(ct_str$conf.int[2],2), 
             "]")

cres_lean <-paste0("r = ", 
             round(ct_lean$estimate,2), 
             ", 95% CI: [",
             round(ct_lean$conf.int[1],2), 
             ", ",
             round(ct_lean$conf.int[2],2), 
             "]")


p <- dat_vl %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = RM10:RM30) %>%
  mutate(measure = "Vastus lateralis thickness") %>%
  bind_rows(dat_str %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = RM10:RM30) %>%
  mutate(measure = "Average unilateral strength")) %>%
  bind_rows(dat_lean %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = RM10:RM30) %>%
  mutate(measure = "Leg lean mass")) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = name, values_from = value) %>%
  
  mutate(measure = factor(measure, levels = c("Vastus lateralis thickness", 
                                              "Leg lean mass", 
                                              "Average unilateral strength"))) %>%


  ggplot(aes(RM10, RM30, change)) + 
  
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, 
                lty = 2, color = "gray40") + 
  
  geom_point(shape = 21, 
             fill = colors[1], 
             size = 2.5) + 

  
  annotate("text", x = 45, y = 42, label = "y = x", angle = 45) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-10, 55)) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-10, 55)) +
  
  labs(x = "Relative change in 10RM (%)", 
       y = "Relative change in 30RM (%)") +
  
  theme_classic(base_size = basesize) +
  
  facet_wrap(~ measure) + 
  theme(strip.text = element_text(hjust = 0), 
        strip.background = element_rect(color = "white"))
  


ggsave("ecss-2024-figures/fig2.pdf", 
       p,
       width = 24, 
       height = 10, units = "cm")


p

```




### Effects of baseline relative fat mass and training condition on Vastus lateralis thickness


```{r}
#| label: "fig-fig3"
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-cap: !expr 'glue::glue("Differences between training conditions in training-induced vastus lateralis thickness (mm). {diff}. Accounting for baseline VL thickness and sex.")'



dat <- dat_fm %>%
  
  mutate(change = VLthick_T4 - VLthick_T2) %>%
  filter(condition != "RMNA") %>%
  
  mutate(condition = factor(condition, levels = c("RM10", "RM30"), 
                            labels = c("10RM", "30RM")))



## Calculate differences 

m <- lmerTest::lmer(change ~ VLthick_T2 + condition + sex + (1|participant), 
          data = dat)


## Averages

avg_dat <- data.frame(avg_predictions(m, by = c("condition"), 
                           re.form = NA))




diff <- paste0("Mean difference 30RM vs. 10RM: ", 
               round(coef(summary(m))[3,1],2), 
               " mm, 95% CI: [",
               round(confint(m)[5,1],2), 
               ", ",
               round(confint(m)[5,2],2), 
               "], p = ", 
               round(coef(summary(m))[3,5],3))



p <- dat %>%
  
  
  ggplot(aes(condition, change, size = rel.fm_T2, fill = condition)) +
  
  
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, lty = 2, 
             color = "gray") +
  
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.2), 
             alpha = 0.2, shape = 21) + 
  
     geom_errorbar(data = filter(avg_dat, condition == "10RM"), 
             aes(condition, estimate, size = NULL, ymin = conf.low, 
                 ymax = conf.high),
            width = 0, size= 0.5,
             position = position_nudge(x = -0.3)) +
  
  geom_point(data = filter(avg_dat, condition == "10RM"), 
             aes(condition, estimate, size = NULL),
             size = 3,shape = 21,
             position = position_nudge(x = -0.3)) +
  
     geom_errorbar(data = filter(avg_dat, condition == "30RM"), 
             aes(condition, estimate, size = NULL, ymin = conf.low, 
                 ymax = conf.high),
            width = 0, size= 0.5,
             position = position_nudge(x = 0.3)) +
  
  geom_point(data = filter(avg_dat, condition == "30RM"), 
             aes(condition, estimate, size = NULL),
             size = 3,shape = 21,
             position = position_nudge(x = 0.3)) +

  
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("orange", "orchid"), 
                               guide = "none") + 
  labs(size = "Baseline relative\nfat mass (%)", 
       y = "Vastus lateralis\nthickness change (mm)", 
       x = "Training condition") +
  
  
  theme_classic(base_size = basesize)

p


ggsave("ecss-2024-figures/fig3.pdf", 
       p,
       width = 26, 
       height = 18, units = "cm")

```



```{r}
#| label: "fig-fig4"
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 5
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-cap: !expr 'glue::glue("Association between baseline relative fat mass and vastus lateralis thickness change. For every %-point increase in baseline relative fat mass, VL thickness was estimated to be reduced by {relfm_eff}. Estimates are conditional on sex and baseline VL thickness. Duplicate observations (training conditions) from participants are accounted for in a mixed effects model.")'



dat <- dat_fm %>%
  
  mutate(change = 100 * ((VLthick_T4 / VLthick_T2)-1)) %>%
  filter(condition != "RMNA") %>%
  
  mutate(condition = factor(condition, levels = c("RM10", "RM30"), 
                            labels = c("10RM", "30RM")))



## Model without interaction

m2 <- lmerTest::lmer(VLthick_T4 ~ rel.fm_T2 + VLthick_T2 + sex + (1|participant), 
                    data = dat)

# Model summary ###############
relfm_eff <- paste0(round(coef(summary(m2))[2,1],3), 
                    " mm. 95% CI: [",
                    round(confint(m2, method = "profile")[4,1], 3), 
                    ", ",
                    round(confint(m2, method = "profile")[4,2], 3),
                    "], p = ", 
                    round(coef(summary(m2))[2,5],3),
                    ".")




preds2 <- predictions(m2, 
            newdata = expand_grid(rel.fm_T2 = seq(from = 18, to = 64, by = 4), 
                                  VLthick_T2 = seq(from = min(dat$VLthick_T2), 
                                                   to = max(dat$VLthick_T2),
                                                   length.out = 12),
                                  sex = c("m", "f"),
                                  participant = NA), 
            by = c("rel.fm_T2","VLthick_T2"),
            re.form = NA) %>%
  data.frame() 

p <- dat %>%

  ggplot(aes(VLthick_T2, VLthick_T4)) + 
  
  geom_point(shape = 21, 
             fill = colors[1], 
             size = 2) + 
  
  geom_line(data = preds2, 
            aes(x = VLthick_T2, 
                y = estimate, 
             
                color = rel.fm_T2, 
                group = rel.fm_T2), 
            linewidth = 1) + 
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, 
              slope = 1, 
              lty = 2, 
              color = "gray50") + 
  annotate("text", x = 20, y = 18.5, label = "No growth", 
           color = "gray50", angle = 45) +
  theme_classic(base_size = basesize) + 
  labs(x = "Baseline Vastus\nlateralis thickness (mm)", 
       y = "Post-intervention vastus\n lateralis thickness (mm)", 
       color = "Baseline relative\nfat mass (%)") + 

  theme(strip.background = element_rect(color = "white"), 
        strip.text = element_text(hjust = 0))
  

p

ggsave("ecss-2024-figures/fig4.pdf", 
       p,
       width = 20, 
       height = 16, units = "cm")


```

```{r}
                  ymin = conf.low,

              fill = "gray50", 
              alpha = 0.2) +
  
  
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(colors[2], colors[3])) +

       y = "Vastus lateralis\nthickness change (%)",
```

## Leg lean mass (DXA)

```{r}
#| label: "fig-fig6"
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-cap: !expr 'glue::glue("Association between baseline relative fat mass and leg lean mass change. For every %-point increase in baseline relative fat mass, training-induced change leg lean mass was estimated to be affected by {relfm_eff_change}. Each participants contributes duplicate measures to the model (training conditions), these are accounted for in a mixed-effects model that also accounts for sex and baseline lean mass.")'




dat <- part %>% 
  mutate(participant = as.character(participant)) %>%
  inner_join(AOData::bodycomp) %>%
  
  mutate(rel.fm = 100 * (fat.legs / (fat.legs + lean.legs + BMC.legs))) %>%
  
  select(participant, time, sex, bmi, rel.fm, lean.right_leg, lean.left_leg) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = lean.right_leg:lean.left_leg, 
               values_to = "lean_leg", 
               names_to = "leg") %>%
  mutate(leg = if_else(leg == "lean.right_leg", "R", "L")) %>%

  inner_join(mutate(AOData::thickness, participant = as.character(participant))) %>%
  select(-VIthick) %>%

  filter(time %in% c("T2", "T4")) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = time, 
              values_from = c(VLthick, lean_leg, rel.fm)) %>%
  
  mutate(change_lean = 100 * ((lean_leg_T4 / lean_leg_T2)-1), 
         abs_change_lean = lean_leg_T4 - lean_leg_T2,
         change_thick = VLthick_T4- VLthick_T2)  %>%
 
  filter(condition != "RMNA") %>%

  mutate(condition = factor(condition, levels = c("RM10", "RM30"), 
                            labels = c("10RM", "30RM"))) 



m <- lmerTest::lmer(change_lean ~ scale(lean_leg_T2) + rel.fm_T2 + sex + (1|participant), 
                    data = dat)


relfm_eff_change <- paste0("Average : ",
```

```{r}
str_dat <- AOData::strength %>%
  
  inner_join(part) %>%
  
  select(participant:mag, sex) %>%
  filter(time %in% c("T2", "T4"), 
         condition != "RMNA") %>%
  

  
  
  pivot_wider(names_from = time, values_from = mag) %>%
  
  filter(T2 > 5, T4 > 0) %>%
  
  mutate(change = log(T4) - log(T2), 
         pre = log(T2) -  mean(log(T2)), 
         .by = exercise) 


exercises <- unique(str_dat$exercise)
preds_single <- list()
compr <- list()

for(i in seq_along(exercises))  {
  
  dat <- str_dat %>%
    filter(exercise == exercises[i])
  
  
  mstr <- lmerTest::lmer(change ~ condition + pre + sex + (1|participant), 
               dat = dat) 
  
  
  conf <- confint(mstr)
  
  
  compr[[i]] <- cbind(data.frame(coef(summary(mstr)), row.names = NULL)[2,], data.frame(lwr = conf[4,1], upr = conf[4,2])) %>%
    mutate(exercise = exercises[i])
        
       
        
  
  preds_single[[i]] <- predictions(mstr, newdata = expand_grid(condition = c("RM10", "RM30"), 
                                                   pre = 0, 
                                                   sex = c("m", "f"),
                                                   participant = NULL), 
                                   by = "condition",
                       re.form=NA) %>%
  
  

  
  
    data.frame() %>%
    mutate(change = 100 * (exp(estimate)-1), 
           lwr = 100 * (exp(conf.low)-1), 
           upr = 100 * (exp(conf.high)-1)) %>%
    select(condition, change, lwr, upr) %>%
    mutate(condition = factor(condition, levels = c("RM10", "RM30"), 
                              labels = c("10RM", "30RM")), 
           exercise = exercises[i])
  
  
  
}
```

## Sex interactions


```{r}
#| label: "fig-fig10"
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-cap: !expr 'glue::glue("There were no differences between males and females in leg lean mass changes (%) (p = {sex.lean.p}). Males and females showed similar changes in lean mass across training conditions (p = {sex.lean_cond.p}) and baseline relative fat mass (p = {sex.lean_fm.p})")'





  
### Lean mass sex interaction ###
lean_dat <- part %>% 
  mutate(participant = as.character(participant)) %>%
  inner_join(AOData::bodycomp) %>%
  
  mutate(rel.fm = 100 * (fat.whole / (fat.whole + lean.whole + BMC.whole))) %>%

  
  select(participant, time, sex, bmi, rel.fm, lean.right_leg, lean.left_leg) %>%

  pivot_longer(cols = lean.right_leg:lean.left_leg, 
               values_to = "lean_leg", 
               names_to = "leg") %>%
  mutate(leg = if_else(leg == "lean.right_leg", "R", "L")) %>%


  inner_join(mutate(AOData::thickness, participant = as.character(participant))) %>%
  select(-VIthick) %>%

  filter(time %in% c("T2", "T4")) %>%
  select(-VLthick) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = time, 
               values_from = c(rel.fm, lean_leg)) %>%
  
  mutate(change = 100 * ((lean_leg_T4 / lean_leg_T2)-1)) %>%
  mutate(.by = sex, 
         scaled.t2 = (lean_leg_T2 - mean(lean_leg_T2)) / sd(lean_leg_T2)) 
  
  
## Models ##

m0 <- lmerTest::lmer(change ~  scaled.t2 + sex + (1|participant), 
                     data = lean_dat)
m1 <- lmerTest::lmer(change ~  scaled.t2 + sex * condition  + (1|participant), 
                     data = lean_dat)
m2 <- lmerTest::lmer(change ~  scaled.t2 + sex * rel.fm_T2  + (1|participant), 
                     data = lean_dat)


sex.lean.p <- round(coef(summary(m0))[3,5], 3)
sex.lean_cond.p <- round(coef(summary(m1))[5,5], 3)
sex.lean_fm.p <- round(coef(summary(m2))[5,5], 3)


string_diff_fun <- function(m1 = m1, m2 = m2, m3 = m3, outcome) {
  
  

m0_pred <- avg_predictions(m1, by = "sex", re.form = NA) %>%
  data.frame()

# Average per sex 
avg_male <- paste0(round(m0_pred[1,2], 1), 
                   "%, [", 
                   round(m0_pred[1,7], 1), 
                   ", ",
                   round(m0_pred[1,8], 1),
                   "]")
avg_female <- paste0(round(m0_pred[2,2], 1), 
                   "%, [", 
                   round(m0_pred[2,7], 1), 
                   ", ",
                   round(m0_pred[2,8], 1),
                   "]")
avg_diff <- paste0(round(coef(summary(m1))[3,1], 1), 
                   "%-points, [", 
                   round(confint(m1)[5,1], 1), 
                   ", ",
                   round(confint(m1)[5,2], 1),
                   "]")


## Avg difference between sets in males and females

m1_comp <- avg_comparisons(m2, re.form = NA, by = c("sex")) %>%
  data.frame()

avg_male_m1 <- paste0(round(m1_comp[2,4], 1), 
                   "%-point, [", 
                   round(m1_comp[2,9], 1), 
                   ", ",
                   round(m1_comp[2,10], 1),
                   "]")
avg_female_m1 <- paste0(round(m1_comp[1,4], 1), 
                   "%-point, [", 
                   round(m1_comp[1,9], 1), 
                   ", ",
                   round(m1_comp[1,10], 1),
                   "]")
avg_diff_m1 <- paste0(round(coef(summary(m2))[5,1], 1), 
                   "%-points, [", 
                   round(confint(m2)[7,1], 1), 
                   ", ",
                   round(confint(m2)[7,2], 1),
                   "]")
## Baseline fat mass 

m2_comp <- avg_comparisons(m3, re.form = NA, by = c("sex")) %>%
  data.frame()

avg_male_m2 <- paste0(round(m2_comp[2,4], 1), 
                   "%-point, [", 
                   round(m2_comp[2,9], 1), 
                   ", ",
                   round(m2_comp[2,10], 1),
                   "]")
avg_female_m2 <- paste0(round(m2_comp[1,4], 1), 
                   "%-point, [", 
                   round(m2_comp[1,9], 1), 
                   ", ",
                   round(m2_comp[1,10], 1),
                   "]")
avg_diff_m2 <- paste0(round(coef(summary(m3))[5,1], 1), 
                   "%-points, [", 
                   round(confint(m3)[7,1], 1), 
                   ", ",
                   round(confint(m3)[7,2], 1),
                   "]")


## Combine information in a string ##

out <- paste0("Male gain in ", outcome, 
              " was ", avg_male, " and in females ", 
              avg_female, ". The average estimated difference between males and females was ", avg_diff,
              ". The average difference between conditions was ", 
              avg_male_m1, " in male and ", 
              avg_female_m1, " in females. The differences between sexes condition-differences was estimated to ", 
              avg_diff_m1, ". For every percentage-point increase in baseline fat mass, males were estimated to have a ", 
              avg_male_m2, " and females ", avg_female_m2,
              " difference in ", outcome, " training induced change. Difference between sexes was estimated to ", avg_diff_m2, ".")


return(out)
  
  
}





## Plot condition per sex

                re.form = NA) %>%
  
  data.frame() %>%
             mutate(sex = factor(sex, levels = c("f", "m"),

  ggplot(aes(condition, change, color = condition)) +

             size = 3, 
             shape = 21) +
  
  
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.1),
```

```{r}
#| label: "fig-fig12"
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-cap: !expr 'glue::glue("Females showed greater increases in average strength (%) (p = {sex.str.p}) with no differences between males and females across training conditions (p = {sex.str_cond.p}) os baseline relative fat mass (p = {sex.str_fm.p})")'


## Strength ###

str_dat <- AOData::strength %>%
  
  inner_join(part) %>%
  
  select(participant:mag) %>%
  filter(time %in% c("T2", "T4"), 
         condition != "RMNA", 
         mag > 5) %>%
 
  mutate(.by = exercise, 
         mag = mag/max(mag)) %>%
  summarise(.by = c(participant, condition, time), 
            mag = mean(mag)) %>%
  

  pivot_wider(names_from = time, values_from = mag) %>%
  mutate(change = 100 * ((T4/T2)-1), 
         participant = as.character(participant)) %>%
  
  inner_join(part %>% 
               mutate(participant = as.character(participant)) %>%
               inner_join(AOData::bodycomp) %>%
               
               mutate(rel.fm = 100 * (fat.whole / (fat.whole + lean.whole + BMC.whole))) %>%
              
               filter(time == "T2") %>%
               select(participant, rel.fm, sex)) %>%
    mutate(.by = sex, 
         scaled.t2 = (T2 - mean(T2)) / sd(T2)) 

## Models ##

strm0 <- lmerTest::lmer(change ~  scaled.t2 + sex   + (1|participant), 
                     data = str_dat)
strm1 <- lmerTest::lmer(change ~  scaled.t2 + sex * condition  + (1|participant), 
                     data = str_dat)
strm2 <- lmerTest::lmer(change ~  scaled.t2 + sex * rel.fm  + (1|participant), 
                     data = str_dat)


sex.str.p <- round(coef(summary(strm0))[3,5], 3)
sex.str_cond.p <- round(coef(summary(strm1))[5,5], 3)
sex.str_fm.p <- round(coef(summary(strm2))[5,5], 3)




## Plot condition per sex
str_pred <- avg_predictions(strm1, by = c("sex", "condition"), 
                re.form = NA) %>%
  
  data.frame() %>%
             mutate(sex = factor(sex, levels = c("f", "m"), 
                      labels = c("Female", "Male")))  %>%
    mutate(condition = factor(condition, levels = c("RM10", "RM30"), 
                            labels = c("10RM", "30RM"))) 

sex_str_fig <- str_dat %>%
  filter(condition != "RMNA") %>%
  mutate(sex = factor(sex, levels = c("f", "m"), 
                      labels = c("Female", "Male"))) %>%
    mutate(condition = factor(condition, levels = c("RM10", "RM30"), 
                            labels = c("10RM", "30RM"))) %>%

  ggplot(aes(condition, change, color = condition)) + 
  
  geom_errorbar(data = filter(str_pred, condition == "10RM"),
             aes(condition, estimate, ymin = conf.low, 
                 ymax = conf.high, 
                 color = NULL), 
             position = position_nudge(x = -0.3), 
             width = 0) +
  
  
  geom_point(data = filter(str_pred, condition == "10RM"),
             aes(condition, estimate, fill = condition, color = NULL), 
             position = position_nudge(x = -0.3), 
             size = 3, 
             shape = 21) +
  
    
  geom_errorbar(data = filter(str_pred, condition == "30RM"),
             aes(condition, estimate, ymin = conf.low, 
                 ymax = conf.high, 
                 color = NULL), 
             position = position_nudge(x = 0.3), 
             width = 0) +
  
  
  geom_point(data = filter(str_pred, condition == "30RM"),
             aes(condition, estimate, fill = condition, color = NULL), 
             position = position_nudge(x = 0.3), 
             size = 3, 
             shape = 21) +
  
  
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.1), 
             alpha = 0.6) +
  
    
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(colors[2], colors[3])) + 
    
  scale_color_manual(values = c(colors[2], colors[3])) + 
  
    labs(y = "Average strength\n change (%)") +
  
  facet_wrap(~ sex, ncol = 2) +
  
  theme_classic(base_size = basesize) +
  
    theme(strip.text = element_text(hjust = 0), 
        strip.background = element_rect(color = "white"), 
        axis.title.x = element_blank(), 
        legend.title= element_blank(), 
        legend.position = "none")
```
